scope: read-only current registered map JSON, current layout ownership, nominal four-neighbor grid routes
limits: boundingArea includes neighbor context and sea; not playable/owned area
routes ignore dynamic NPC/event collisions, weather, load and diagonal shortcuts; seconds are not human play time
a one-cell inset on a team map is grouped as screen-edge-adjacent; >1 is the interior statistic
B1 areas are budgets; M4 export area is a prior generation report, not freshly regenerated ownership; routes use current production JSON
